body:
Evidence moved here from objectstack-ai/objectstack#22191. The maintainer asked for this defect to be filed (`useObjectFields` reads only the published object). The session that filed it could not search this repository. objectstack-ai/objectstack#22191 is closed as a duplicate of this card. What it adds:

- **The gap is sharper on `main` than at the pin.** objectui#11783 (`57dbe34`) made the object picker read `GET /api/v1/meta/object?preview=draft`. An author can now *choose* the draft object and still gets no fields for it.
- **The path.** `useFlowScope` calls `useObjectFields(scope.trigger?.objectName)`. On the 404 the hook answers `fields: []` with `notFound: true`. That leaves only `previous` and the whole-record `record` ref (objectui#11789) in scope.
- **The same hook serves other Studio consumers on `main`:**
  - `FlowReferenceField` and `FlowNodeConfigField`'s record-node field pickers
  - `ObjectFieldInspector`, `AppNavInspector`
  - `ViewColumnInspector`, `ViewVariantInspector`, `ObjectListViewInspector`
  - `PageBlockInspector`, `ActionDefaultInspector`

  Each is presumably field-blind for a draft-only object too. That was measured only on the flow Start node, so the fix belongs in the hook, not in one caller.
- **The read to reuse.** The validations panel on the same screen already reads the draft: `GET /api/v1/meta/object/repair_ticket?state=draft&package=PKG` answers 200 with the fields.
- **Still on `main`:** unchanged on objectui `main` `b6f8fc87` (2026-10-08).

---

Grade (triage): `pm:queue` added. **p2 stands**: a draft-only trigger object offers no fields, so an author has to type CEL (measured).

- **Pins:** a draft-only object's fields appear in the entry-condition builder; control: a published object is unchanged.
- **Duplicate folded in:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#22191, closed into this card.

The read becomes the draft-overlaid object, falling back to the published one, per triage's direction `6053408714`. The hook's signature and its result shape are unchanged.
- The tests beside it, and `.changeset/11895-*.md`.

⛔ Not on it:
- `ConditionBuilder`'s operators and compile path (seat 3's objectui#11894, p1). Its claim declares this hook an adjacent region, and whoever lands second merges `main`.
- The hook's consumers: `useFlowScope`, `FlowNodeConfigField`, `FlowReferenceField`, `ObjectFieldInspector`, `AppNavInspector`, `ViewColumnInspector`, `ViewVariantInspector`, `ObjectListViewInspector` (this seat's objectui#11799 remainder), `PageBlockInspector` and `ActionDefaultInspector`. They change nothing. If one needs a change, the dev reports it.
- `metadata-client.ts`, `packages/i18n/**` and `packages/components/src/ui/**`.

Any file outside this list: the dev reports it before opening the PR (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over this path: no path-derived mandate; default tier)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui app-shell Studio: the flow entry-condition builder and every field picker reading useObjectFields offer no fields for a draft-only object, so an author must type CEL | the platform path is right: the draft-overlaid read (?preview=draft, objectui#11783's picker) answers the draft's fields; the published read 404s by design | every author building automations before the first publish`
Thread-read: `6053408714`
Serial constraints cleared: `none` blocking.
- **`area:workflow` in flight:** none on the board. objectui#11905 (p2, `area:workflow`) is queued, not in flight.
- **Adjacent in-flight claim:** seat 3's objectui#11894 fences `useObjectFields` out of its surface and names this card as its owner (its claim's `⛔ Not on it` line).
- **Open objectui PRs:** none touches `useObjectFields.ts`. Read 2026-10-08T06:31Z.
- **This seat:** dispatch is parallel, `batch` 3 working devs, on the maintainer's word in this session's chat (「改为并行派发，batch 3」, 「继续派发」), paced by the shared hourly write budget.
  - objectui#11862's dev has finished (PR objectui#11906), which freed this slot.
  - Working with this card: objectui#11872's dev and objectui#11799's (remainder).

Why `Clause-②: no`: a client read inside one hook. Its exports, signature and result shape stay as they are, and the server's answers are unchanged.

## Seat ruling on the dev's open question (report `6055355527`) · claim amendment

`domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01DrKzdPdyLLBW3qpZ4vtk7z` · read on `main` `d52d908`, 2026-10-08T07:54Z.

### The question: the fix turns 39 existing test files red, and they are outside the fence. Ruled A

- **Measured:** each of the 39 files mocks `../useMetadata` with a metadata-client double that has no `withPreviewDrafts` (37 files), or one whose `withPreviewDrafts` returns only `list` (2 files). The hook then throws `client.withPreviewDrafts is not a function`. All 39 are green with the fix ablated and red with it in place, so the doubles are the only cause.
- **Why A:**
  - The doubles predate the client's declared `withPreviewDrafts`. Completing them is the honest fix, one mechanical change per file with no assertion changes.
  - **B** (the hook calls the method only if it exists, else reads the published object) is a consumer-side tolerance that exists only for incomplete doubles. It would silently hide this card's defect from any real client that lost the method.
  - **C** (hold the card until objectui#11894 lands) idles a finished fix for an unknown time, for an overlap that is additive.

### Claim amendment

The file surface of claim `6053914459` gains the 39 test files the report lists (its carrier line), with only their metadata-client doubles changed:
- **Shape 1** (37 files): add `withPreviewDrafts` returning the same double, so the test's own `get` stub keeps answering.
- **Shape 2** (`FlowReferenceField.objectPicker-11783`, `ObjectFieldInspector.objectPicker-11783`): the object their `withPreviewDrafts` returns also carries `get`.

⛔ No assertion, fixture or test name changes. The rest of the claim stands, `Clause-②: no` included.

### The overlap with seat 3's objectui#11894 (p1, in flight, no PR yet)

- Nine of the files (`ConditionBuilder.test.tsx` and its `.celGate`, `.clientMountRoots`, `.contextSubjects`, `.mountRoots`, `.mountScope`, `.placeholderRoots`, `.referenceValue` and `.subjectVocabulary` siblings) are among objectui#11894's "tests beside them".
- This card's edit there is additive, one property in each file's `vi.mock` double. Whoever lands second merges `main`.
- A note goes on objectui#11894 in this pass, so its dev expects it.
